import asyncio
from aiomonitor import Monitor
from aiomonitor.termui.commands import monitor_cli
from aiomonitor.context import command_done
from click.testing import CliRunner

async def main():
    m = Monitor(asyncio.get_running_loop(), max_snapshots=2)
    m._ui_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    t = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.sleep(60), name='snapshot-check')
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    a = await m.capture_snapshot('named')
    assert a == 1
    saved = m.format_snapshot_task_list(a)
    assert any(x.task_id == str(id(t)) for x in saved)
    assert any(x.type == 'header' for x in m.format_snapshot_task_stack(a, id(t)))
    t.cancel()
    try: await t
    except asyncio.CancelledError: pass
    b = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert any(x.task_id == str(id(t)) for x in m.format_snapshot_diff(a,b).removed)
    c = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert [s.id for s in m.list_snapshots()] == [a,c]
    try: m.get_snapshot(b)
    except KeyError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError('missing snapshot')
    event = asyncio.Event(); token = command_done.set(event)
    try:
        r = CliRunner().invoke(monitor_cli, ['snapshot','ls'], obj=m)
        print('CLI', r.exit_code, repr(r.output), repr(r.exception), 'done', event.is_set())
        assert r.exit_code == 0 and event.is_set()
    finally: command_done.reset(token)
    print('Snapshot checks passed')
asyncio.run(main())
